title: Vesper and the Typewriter
author: Ada Joubert
blurb: Wren Dunmore, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, has spent ten years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
